title: SOLICITATION_SERVICENOW STAFF AUGMENTATION SERVICES
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSEA > REGIONAL MAINTENANCE CENTER > SOUTHWEST REGIONAL MAINT CENTER
description:
This is a Combined Synopsis/Solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with the format in RFO FAR 12.201-1, additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are requested of competent vendors, as identified hereunder. 

  

 Request for Quotation (RFQ) N5523627Q0003 is issued as full and open competition. The subject solicitation is being processed using the procedures of RFO FAR Part 12. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 541512 – Computer Systems Design Services. 

  

 This solicitation documents and incorporates provisions and clauses that are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular 2026-01 (Effective 02 July 2026) and DFARS Publication Notice 20260702. 

  

 DESCRIPTION: Southwest Regional Maintenance Center (SWRMC) requires procurement of professional technical services in support of SWRMC at Naval Base San Diego. 

  

  SEE STATEMENT OF WORK   

  

  Projected Period of Performance (PoP):   

 Base Period: 01 December 2026 – 31 March 2027 

 Option Period (1): 01 April 2027 – 31 July 2027 

 Option Period (2): 01 August 2027 – 30 November 2027 

  

 The full text of FAR and DFAR references, provisions and clauses may be accessed at https://acquisition.gov. 

  

 SENSITIVE ACTIVITY AND INTELLIGENCE-RELATED CONTRACTING (SAIRC) AND OPERATIONS SECURITY (OPSEC) STATEMENT 

 This contracting action has been reviewed against the requirement of SECNAVINST S4200.35. SAIRC protections are not required.
